meta.title: Buka Skills
meta.description: Adds a Skills page to the sidebar: Skill repositories keeps a personal list of skill sources, probes each listable source as a standard npx repository (only SKILL.md under the root skills/ directory) or unavailable, and expands the usable ones into a cached tree; any skill or directory can be installed globally, into a worker, or into a registered workspace. Global skills lists the skills installed globally for every DSH session, marks the ones the skills library manages, and checks for updates automatically once the list loads. Install, uninstall and update share one queue, and the workers page can update one worker at a time or every worker in sequence.
